README: The sound sheet. Each cue and word mirrors a visible action. Echoes keep one low plink as their signature; music moves from wonder to a held breath, then hope.

beds.why: The first gym wall is at school, before the day quiets down.

After school, the gym and stage are empty enough to hear every echo.
